Hard line drive = launch angle 5 to 25 and hit power 180+, in play. Popout uses the game's own commentary rule: initial vertical speed over 80000 and first bounce within 1600 of the plate, and a fielder gets there. Gapper = line drive (launch 0 to 30) that no fielder can reach. Fielders wait the game's 10-tick auto-fielding delay, then run to the earliest point on the ball's expected path they can reach. They plan on the clean hops, so a random bounce can beat them. Ground pickups roll the game's coordination check, and a failed roll pops the ball up 15% of the time (intercept AI, sharper than hard mode and no error rolls). Online defenses are human-steered, so real averages run higher than this. Easy out = a fielder is under a fly ball with 8+ ticks to spare, or an infielder fields a grounder and the throw beats the runner by 8+ ticks. Contested = close either way. Gapper = fair ball that stays in the park and lands before any fielder could reach it, against a generic defense at the game's default positions (speed 7 outfielders, 6 infielders, 140 reach). Whiffs count contact quality 0 or less. Fouls are not strikeouts here, just balls that landed foul.
